criteria.acceptance: Exact owner-approved G0/G1 intent and canonical Engagement Core spec SHA retained; no omitted S01-S15 screen, no silent simplification.
Fifteen screens retain distinct information architectures and WordPress backend ownership contracts; no real channel claim.
All 15 wireframes and five design states are represented in actual, inspectable screenshots, not source-only claims.
Inbox to Conversation to Customer 360 and Pipeline to Deal to Task navigations operate in a real browser.
Actual browser checks at 320, 360, 375, 390, 414, 768, 800, 1024 and 1440 pixels show no document overflow.
Mobile bottom navigation, adaptive desktop sidebar, customer context and stage changes have intentional touch and keyboard paths.
Controls have accessible names, visible focus and a working keyboard path; impossible or inactive backend actions are marked design-only.
Empty, loading, error and denied states disclose real recovery path and do not discard drafts silently.
Tabler MIT provenance preserved with local assets, unapproved paid assets/API integrations forbidden, and CRM data remains WordPress-owned.
A design/art director independent of the author reviews actual screenshot evidence for hierarchy, spacing, contrast, mobile ergonomics and semantics; a model may critique but never self-approve.
Creative quality and owner approval remain pending until separately confirmed by the owner after a complete visual walkthrough; automated test success is not acceptance.
Existing working PR #74, original WordPress CRM data, baseline 27 UI and 16 backend synthetic tests, rollback refs and production remain untouched.
CRM-specific bounded continuous review must not repurpose the Shaadi AI art director or its data; current Manager V3 is observation-only.
Unknown project, wrong branch, swapped artifact, mismatched pinned brief and missing owner approval deny the controlled build; a no-release verdict is mandatory.
